Metafield: custom.how_to_use [multi_line:
Light all sides — hold a steady flame around the whole rim for about 20 seconds and let the herbs awaken.

Keep the flame — let it burn 20 seconds more so the base fully catches. Don't rush it.

Look for the amber glow — blow out gently. When the tip glows warm orange-amber all over, you did it right — pure burn, pure aroma, nothing left but ash.

Tip: if a cup stops burning, it isn't a defect — the lighting simply wasn't complete. Relight all sides for the full 20 seconds.
